purpose: Bind the Jicamarca Río Seco child to the correct official ANA regulatory corridor and exact published coordinate framework without promoting a faja marginal to catchment geometry, event footprint, channel centerline, outlet, confluence, routing or activation evidence.

official_identity.project_context: Mejoramiento y ampliación del servicio de protección ante inundaciones y movimiento de masas en la quebrada Huaycoloro
official_identity.official_relation_note: The ANA resolution delimits Quebrada Río Seco together with nine tributary/reach sections and documents Colca and El Silencio within that regulatory study. This contract does not reinterpret those names into a synthetic basin topology.

regulatory_geometry_evidence.reason_map_withheld: Exact source bytes and complete hito table have not yet been frozen/replayed in-repository. Even after that gate, any publication may only be a separate regulatory-context layer, not local activation geometry.

cross_check_with_existing_igp_freeze.rule: The ANA identity anchor strengthens rejection of the geographically incompatible same-name IGP feature; it does not authorize selecting a replacement line by name alone.

next_gate: freeze exact public source bytes and SHA-256 or an equivalently immutable official representation
extract the complete 270 main Río Seco marginal hitos preserving bank, source order and EPSG:32718
validate exact counts, coordinate ranges and deterministic WGS84 reprojection before any regulatory-context map publication
keep the regulatory faja as a separate context layer; do not convert it into a catchment polygon, channel centerline or historical event footprint
resolve natural channel/catchment geometry and outlet/confluence from independent reproducible hydrographic or DEM evidence before collector coupling
forbidden: treat faja marginal as event footprint
treat faja marginal as catchment polygon
derive channel centerline by averaging or interpolating opposite-bank hitos without a separately preregistered and validated method
infer outlet or Rímac confluence from regulatory endpoints
infer discharge, capacity, travel time or attenuation from the 26 km regulatory length
select a same-name Río Seco feature without spatial identity validation
promote Río Seco evidence to Jicamarca parent activation or Rímac overflow
